summary: Round 3 (r3b1): 29.955 (incumbent 28.841): the greedy line gets THROUGH the -y tunnel into the room (6/9 at 7,655M), first time on this map. Diagnosis: with 0.5 units/s of time penalty and free death, dying is optimal at every dip gate (the CP2 pit dive beats the detour + tunnel dive by 0.5 units; a tunnel dive that dies at its end is as good as surviving). Fix (generic, from the trainer's constants): --fail-pen 10 = time_pen/(1-gamma), death = never finishing, so the objective is discounted progress + survival; with --surf-bonus 0 (the bonus is a farm in that frame) and T 0 (--unstuck-max 0). Incumbent ckpt + those flags: pit lock gone in ~150M steps, tunnel dive at its limit (28.85) by 330M, through the tunnel into the room by 380M (29.6-29.95), training ceiling 30.2%. Continuing (r3b1_ifpx).
